Deck.title: Deck
Deck.description: A Commander deck owned by the user, tracking win-loss record and Elo rating.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

partnerCommander.description: Optional partner or background commander name.

colorIdentity.description: MTG color identity codes (W, U, B, R, G, C), up to 5 items.

notes.description: Optional deck notes or archetype tags.

archived.description: Whether the deck is archived from active rotation.

peakElo.description: Highest Elo rating achieved by this deck.

gamesPlayed.description: Total matches played with this deck.

lastEloDelta.description: Elo change from the most recent match.

Opponent.title: Opponent
Opponent.description: A playgroup opponent tracked against the user, including head-to-head win rate and Elo rating.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

avatarColorHex.description: Hex color string (#RRGGBB) for avatar badge.

gamesPlayed.description: Total logged pods this opponent participated in.

wins.description: Total pods won by this opponent.

winsAgainstUser.description: Matches where this opponent won while the user lost.

lossesToUser.description: Matches where the user won against this opponent.

lastEloDelta.description: Elo change from the most recent match.

MatchRecord.title: MatchRecord
MatchRecord.description: A recorded Commander pod match with participants, outcome, and computed Elo changes.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

deckId.description: Document ID of the user's deck played.

deckName.description: Snapshot name of the user's deck.

deckCommander.description: Snapshot commander of the user's deck.

deckColorIdentity.description: Color identity snapshot of the user's deck.

opponentIds.description: Document IDs of opponents in the pod (1-5).

opponentNames.description: Names of opponents in the pod aligned with opponentIds.

opponentCommanders.description: Optional commander names played by opponents.

outcome.description: Match outcome from the user's perspective.

winnerType.description: Who won the pod (single player, multi-winner team, or draw).

winningOpponentId.description: Document ID of the winning opponent when winnerType is OPPONENT.

winningOpponentName.description: Name of the winning opponent when winnerType is OPPONENT.

winningOpponentIds.description: Document IDs of winning opponents when winnerType is TEAM (1-5).

winningOpponentNames.description: Names of winning opponents aligned with winningOpponentIds when winnerType is TEAM.

podSize.description: Total number of players in the pod (2-6).

turnCount.description: Optional turn count when the game ended.

deckEloBefore.description: Deck Elo prior to this match.

deckEloDelta.description: Deck Elo delta from this match.

opponentEloDeltas.description: Map of opponentId to Elo delta from this match.

playedAtMillis.description: Epoch milliseconds when the match was played.

/users/{userId}/decks/{deckId}.description: User-owned Commander decks with record and Elo stats.

/users/{userId}/opponents/{opponentId}.description: User-tracked playgroup opponents with win rate against user and Elo stats.

/users/{userId}/matches/{matchId}.description: User-recorded Commander pod match history and Elo deltas.
